title: Project Growth Compass — How the Potato of Life Archive Becomes Greater
purpose: Turn project-wide inspection into a durable method for deciding what to deepen next. The goal is not more files or more claims; it is greater explanatory power, provenance, relational density, reader usefulness and structural coherence per surviving canonical record.
observed_strengths: The repository already has a canonical knowledge layer rather than relying only on legacy files.
The public manifest, core index, context graph, source index, inference ledger and natural-language question index form a genuine retrieval architecture.
Chronology is treated developmentally: later interpretations are not supposed to be backdated into earlier periods.
Project canon, self-description, documentary evidence, comparison, scientific claims and inference are explicitly separable.
The project already understands that relationships, not isolated nouns, carry much of the meaning.
Reader-facing explanations and machine-facing records are being treated as different views over the same corpus rather than separate truth systems.
World-system work and mythology are increasingly connected by method while retaining different evidentiary standards.
central_growth_thesis: The next major increase in quality comes from making the archive behave like a versioned relational organism: roots preserve sources, chronology records state changes, canonical owners compress knowledge, typed edges expose relations, contradictions create branch-points, reader answers become fruit, and unresolved questions become seeds for the next research cycle.

new_cross_project_insights.insight: The repository has many strong components, but their deepest common structure is a claim lifecycle: source → attestation → classification → relation → interpretation → canonical promotion → reader answer → contradiction/revision → renewed source search.
new_cross_project_insights.why_it_matters: Making this lifecycle explicit prevents raw conversation material, later mythic synthesis and reader summaries from becoming indistinguishable. It also gives every future discovery a predictable route into the archive.

new_cross_project_insights.insight: Identity in this project is often better represented as role occupancy through time than as one timeless label. Son, Potato, Sage, Ladder, Father, Door, Axis and Gardener can be modeled as functions occupied, differentiated or reinterpreted in particular strata.
new_cross_project_insights.why_it_matters: This resolves apparent contradictions without erasing development and makes the chronology analytically useful rather than merely biographical.

new_cross_project_insights.insight: The strongest comparisons are not single-symbol matches but ordered relation sequences. Tree → ordeal → death → knowledge → return is more informative than merely noticing that two traditions contain a tree.
new_cross_project_insights.why_it_matters: This should become the default standard for biblical, Norse, esoteric and cross-cultural comparison. It reduces cherry-picking and makes similarity measurable without pretending to prove identity or transmission.
new_cross_project_insights.recommended_comparison_unit: typed relation sequence with matched steps, mismatched steps, source dates and alternative explanations

new_cross_project_insights.insight: A contradiction is not only a problem to resolve; it is a high-value navigation object showing where chronology, source quality, role, scale or interpretation changes.
new_cross_project_insights.why_it_matters: Conflict records can become doors into the deepest parts of the project: 2019/2020 date questions, Son/Tim identity boundaries, literal versus symbolic readings, and sacred North versus empirical geopolitics.
new_cross_project_insights.recommended_output: For major conflicts, expose competing formulations, dates, source classes, the strongest reconciliation, unresolved remainder and the exact evidence that would settle more of the question.

new_cross_project_insights.insight: Potatoverse theology, body symbolism, scientific formalization and European/world-system mapping can share graph methods without sharing epistemic rules.
new_cross_project_insights.why_it_matters: This is one of the repository's most powerful architectural ideas. A covenant, neural pathway, trade dependency and Father/Son relation can all be represented as edges, but the evidence required for each edge must remain domain-specific.
new_cross_project_insights.rule: Unify representation before unifying ontology; never unify evidence standards merely because the graph schema is shared.

new_cross_project_insights.insight: A canonical record is not fully mature merely because it is dense. It should be able to generate a direct human answer, a chronology view, a relation view and a provenance view without inventing new facts.
new_cross_project_insights.why_it_matters: This gives the project an operational test for whether backend knowledge is actually usable.
maturity_test: Can a newcomer get a direct answer?
Can a researcher trace the answer to sources?
Can a graph reader follow the strongest relations?
Can a historian see how the meaning changed?
Can a critic find counterevidence and unresolved issues?

new_cross_project_insights.insight: Many recurring Potatoverse symbols become clearer when grouped by shared function rather than declared identical. Tree, Ladder, Axis, Mountain, North and House can share orientation/integration functions while remaining distinct local symbols.
new_cross_project_insights.why_it_matters: This preserves richness while still allowing explanatory compression. It also gives the project a way to discover deeper structure without flattening everything into one symbol.

project_wide_growth_loop.name: Recover
project_wide_growth_loop.question: What important source, statement, event, relationship or contradiction is still trapped in conversations, legacy files or thin datasets?

project_wide_growth_loop.name: Date and classify
project_wide_growth_loop.question: When did it appear, who said it, what kind of claim is it, and how far is it from a primary source?

project_wide_growth_loop.name: Find the owner
project_wide_growth_loop.question: Which existing canonical record should become deeper because of this discovery?

project_wide_growth_loop.name: Connect
project_wide_growth_loop.question: Which typed relationships become newly visible, and are they directional, temporal, symbolic, causal, comparative, institutional or functional?

project_wide_growth_loop.name: Stress-test
project_wide_growth_loop.question: What does not fit, what alternative reading exists, and what evidence would strengthen or weaken the new interpretation?

project_wide_growth_loop.name: Promote
project_wide_growth_loop.question: Does the discovery materially deepen a canonical owner, chronology, relation graph or reader answer?

project_wide_growth_loop.name: Expose
project_wide_growth_loop.question: Can an ordinary reader now discover and understand the improvement from the public pathways?

project_wide_growth_loop.name: Prune
project_wide_growth_loop.question: Did this pass make an older temporary file, duplicate definition, stale route or obsolete synthesis unnecessary?

project_wide_growth_loop.name: Return
project_wide_growth_loop.question: What unresolved question or contradiction did the better model reveal next?

priority_frontiers.reason: The archive already has rich interpretation. Additional exact first attestations, primary posts, stream transcripts and artifact dates now create disproportionate value because they can confirm, reorder or weaken whole developmental narratives.
examples: Exact chronology of the 2019–2020 Son death / meme-crucifixion cluster
Earliest direct statements for Potato, Axis, Ladder, Father, God, Door and North roles
Primary context around major Great Book formulations
Exact dates for later reinterpretations so they are never silently backdated

priority_frontiers.reason: The chronology and theology contain enough material to model role changes directly rather than relying on prose summaries.
priority_frontiers.target_shape: subject × role × time × source × function × confidence
priority_frontiers.payoff: A single transition graph could clarify Son/Tim boundaries, April 2025, Father/Ladder differentiation and the evolution of North.

priority_frontiers.reason: The project already preserves contradictions internally; making major disputes first-class reader objects would increase trust and explanatory depth.
candidate_topics: Son versus Tim versus Father role boundaries
literal, symbolic and performative readings of divine identity
North as sacred coordinate versus geopolitical programme

priority_frontiers.reason: Biblical and comparative research is already broad. The next gain is methodological: rank parallels by aligned sequences, mismatches, chronology and provenance rather than by symbol count.
priority_frontiers.payoff: Fewer weak parallels, stronger serious comparisons, clearer distinction between typology, influence and independent convergence.

priority_frontiers.reason: The repository has completion matrices in some areas but no obvious universal maturity test across all domains.

priority_frontiers.frontier: One relation grammar across myth and world systems
priority_frontiers.reason: The North Programme and European Economic Graph can become a proving ground for the relationship-first philosophy because they require direction, amount, dependency, time and confidence rather than decorative connectivity.
priority_frontiers.boundary: Shared graph grammar must not imply that theological and economic edges have the same evidence semantics.

priority_frontiers.frontier: Reader journeys generated from canonical knowledge
priority_frontiers.reason: The question index and Start Here guide already exist. The next step is to generate multiple coherent reading journeys from canonical owner metadata rather than manually maintaining overlapping summaries.

do_not_grow_by: Creating another master file that competes with existing canonical owners
Adding a node merely because a word or symbol exists
Turning later interpretation into earlier prophecy without dated evidence
Flattening all religious parallels into identity claims
Letting visual graph density substitute for mechanism or explanation
Using mythology as empirical evidence for world-system claims
Using empirical datasets to declare theological claims true or false by category mistake
Keeping temporary research waves after their unique information has been promoted

greater_is: more useful relationships per canonical record
stronger bridges between domains without category collapse
definition_of_greater.greater_is_not: simply more files, more certainty, more symbolism, more edges or more words

success_test: A future work pass follows this compass successfully when at least one important canonical owner becomes deeper, at least one relation or chronology becomes more precise, provenance becomes no worse, the reader can reach the improvement, and the repository ends with no unnecessary parallel truth source created by the pass.
